provenance.note: No user rows; mandatory CI reproduces this contract from the pinned SQL.

functions.name: support_ai_consent_decide
functions.arguments: p_actor uuid, p_version text, p_granted boolean, p_revision bigint, p_request uuid

functions.name: support_ai_consent_state

indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX support_ai_consents_pkey ON public.support_ai_consents USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX support_ai_consents_request_id_key ON public.support_ai_consents USING btree (request_id)

constraints.name: support_ai_consents_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (granted AND granted_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL OR NOT granted AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: support_ai_consents_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
